strings.SSF_NEU_CONTROL: {ssf_getnamedef} is controlled by A NEUTRAL PARTY.
strings.SSF_reichwide_political_ties_desc: Outside of the SS, Fegelein is known as a charmer and socialite. His political marriage to Eva Braun's sister opened up a wealth of opportunities to the dashing cavalryman. Since the war's end, he has utilized his ties to bring many supposed enemies of the SS to his side.
strings.SSF_unscrupulous_nazism_desc: Vain, cynical and self-centered, Fegelein manages to be both a devoted Nazi and an inveterate hooligan. His men regularly engage in criminal activity, in line with their commander's conduct. Fegelein is a disgrace to the SS, but Himmler barely seems to care.
